projects.name: Pulzifi
projects.summary: Multi-tenant SaaS that captures page snapshots, detects visual + content changes, and delivers AI-powered insights via SSE, email, and Slack/Teams/Discord webhooks.
projects.descriptionHtml: Designed and built a comprehensive web monitoring platform with schema-per-tenant Postgres, Hono RPC backend, Next.js 16 frontend, and a Patchright-based scraper. The platform features 17 hexagonal/DDD modules, OAuth + JWT auth, real-time SSE notifications, and an LLM-powered insight pipeline using OpenRouter.

projects.name: Travitur CMS Backend
projects.summary: NestJS 11 REST API for content management with Google Drive integration. Modular architecture with role-based access control and hierarchical document organization.
projects.descriptionHtml: Architected a modular NestJS application with 10+ feature modules: authentication, RBAC, content management with unlimited nesting depth, dynamic forms with multi-part file uploads, and bidirectional Google Drive sync via service account auth.

projects.name: Travitur Mobile App
projects.summary: Cross-platform Expo / React Native app for iOS, Android, and Web with offline PDF viewing, dynamic forms, and an admin panel.
projects.descriptionHtml: Built a unified TypeScript Expo app using expo-router with grouped routes, six Zustand stores, expo-secure-store for token persistence, and react-native-pdf with offline caching. Includes a full admin panel for user/role/permission management.

projects.name: jcsoftdev Portfolio
projects.summary: This site! Astro 5 + Hono + React 19 monorepo with Drizzle, Valkey, MinIO, and a data-driven GSAP portfolio.
projects.descriptionHtml: Personal portfolio + engineering blog. Astro SSR public site, Hono RPC API on Bun, React 19 admin SPA with TanStack Router. Powered by Drizzle ORM on Postgres, Valkey caching, isomorphic-dompurify-sanitized MDX, and reduced-motion-safe GSAP timelines.

projects.name: Pharmacy Point-of-Sale
projects.summary: Vue.js + Laravel pharmacy sales and inventory system with normalized MySQL schema and JWT auth.
projects.descriptionHtml: Built a Vue.js + Laravel system using the Service + Repository patterns. Optimized MySQL with composite indexes, eager loading for N+1 queries, and JWT-secured REST APIs. Includes financial reporting, inventory dashboards, and shared-hosting deployment.

projects.name: Real-Time Gas Delivery Tracking
projects.summary: QR-based delivery tracking platform for a Primax subsidiary. Vue.js + Laravel + MySQL with real-time geolocation.
projects.descriptionHtml: Designed a QR-based delivery workflow with Laravel REST APIs, role-based middleware, and request throttling. Vue.js frontend with QR scanning, GPS tracking, lazy loading, and retry logic for unstable mobile networks.

experiences.summaryHtml: Full-Stack Multi-Tenant SaaS for web monitoring with AI-powered insights. Designed and built end-to-end with Go + Hono + Next.js 16, schema-per-tenant Postgres, and a 17-module DDD architecture.

Built a NestJS 11 CMS backend with Google Drive integration AND a cross-platform Expo / React Native mobile app for iOS, Android, and Web. Role-based access control, hierarchical content, dynamic forms, offline PDF viewing.

Designed enterprise microservices in Go and Node.js using hexagonal + DDD on Azure / AWS. Built a Go service deployed on AWS Lambda for parallel processing, plus React/Vue frontends. Enforced 80% test coverage gates.
Delivered SSR/SSG Next.js apps with NestJS backends. Cut response times 76% via Redis caching, deployed to AWS RDS + EC2 + CloudFront. 80% Jest + Cypress coverage.

Optimized landing-page performance and SEO using Next.js SSR + island architecture. Integrated Salesforce + Drupal via a Node.js middleware on EC2. Designed DynamoDB schemas with GSIs for global enterprise traffic.

Built reusable React components for telecom landing pages. Implemented island architecture with selective hydration, custom GTM tracking, AWS Lambda geolocation logic, and WCAG-compliant interactions.
Architected a React + TypeScript ecommerce frontend. Migrated the build from Webpack to Vite, optimized FCP, and deployed via AWS S3 + CloudFront with Lambda support tasks.

Designed software architecture for real-time donation, pharmacy POS, and gas-delivery platforms. Built React + Node.js + MongoDB stacks with WebSockets, deployed on GCP Cloud Run with Cloud Build CI/CD.
